name: OPPO and Realme
steps: Open Settings, Battery, App Battery Management.
Find the app and enable Allow foreground activity.
Enable Allow background activity.
If your phone has Startup Manager or Auto-launch, allow it for the app.
note: This is the guidance NEXGUARD shows for ColorOS. The developer's own phone is an OPPO running ColorOS 5.2.1.

name: Samsung
steps: Open Settings, Battery, Background usage limits.
Remove the app from Sleeping apps and Deep sleeping apps.
Add it to Never sleeping apps.

name: Xiaomi, Redmi and POCO
steps: Open Settings, Apps, Manage apps and choose the app.
Turn on Autostart.
Set Battery saver to No restrictions.

name: Vivo
steps: Open Settings, Battery, Background power consumption management.
Set the app to Allow high background power use.
Enable Autostart in iManager if you see it.

name: Huawei and Honor
steps: Open Settings, Battery, App launch.
Turn off Manage automatically for the app.
Enable Auto-launch, Secondary launch and Run in background.

name: OnePlus
steps: Open Settings, Battery, Battery optimization.
Choose the app and select Don't optimize.
Allow Auto launch in App management if it is shown.

name: Google Pixel
steps: Open Settings, Apps and choose the app.
Open App battery usage.
Select Unrestricted.

name: Other phones
steps: Open Settings, Apps, choose the app, then Battery.
Pick the option that means unrestricted or no optimization.
Search Settings for autostart or background activity.
